rundown: Rams beat Tigers 77-75 at Lahaina Civic Center in Maui, HI. Rams led 55-28 at half-time and held on. Their win chance dropped as low as 29% along the way.
Leading the way — Tigers: David Fuchs 19 pts, 9 reb; Chase Thompson 3 ast. Rams: Josh Pascarelli 16 pts; Jase Butler 5 ast; Carey Booth 5 reb.
Where Rams won it: they shot 51% to 43%, shot 52% from three to 25% and had 14 assists to 13.

Against the closing line (Draft Kings): Tigers closed as 4.5-point favorites and lost outright to Rams; Rams won as the underdog at +154; the total closed at 147.5 and they combined for 152, over by 4.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 26, 12:26 AM ET. It had Tigers 59% and Rams 41%, projecting Tigers 77.3 – Rams 74.9 (152.3 total, Tigers by 2.4).

Final: Tigers 75 – Rams 77. Wrong winner: it had Tigers at 59%, and Rams (41%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Tigers came in with a 7% above average attack and a 5% stingier than average defense (4-3, 78.4 scored and 72 allowed a game over 7 games), worth about 199 and 199 games of evidence. Projected to score 77.3, they scored 75 (−2.3 points, 3% under); projected to allow 74.9, they allowed 77 (+2.1 points, 3% over).

Rams came in with a 5% above average attack and a 2% stingier than average defense (4-3, 77.4 scored and 75.6 allowed a game over 7 games), worth about 199 and 200 games of evidence. Projected to score 74.9, they scored 77 (+2.1 points, 3% over); projected to allow 77.3, they allowed 75 (−2.3 points, 3% under).

The bigger miss was Tigers' scoring (-2.3 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 152 against 152.3 projected (-0.3), about the 49th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±14.5).

Margin: Rams by 2 against Tigers by 2.4 projected, about the 66th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±11).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
CSU ML (+150) at +150: the algo gave it 39% vs 38% fair (+0.2 pts) — won (+1.5u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 38%). CLEM ML (-180) at -180: the algo gave it 61% vs 62% fair (-0.2 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 62%). CSU +3.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 49% vs 49% fair (+0.3 pts) — won (+1u); lost to the closing +4.5 by 1. CLEM -3.5 (-115) at -115: the algo gave it 51% vs 51% fair (-0.3 pts) — lost (-1u); beat the closing -4.5 by 1. OVER 147.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (+0.7 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. UNDER 147.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (-0.7 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: spread Rams +3.5 → +4.5.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (DraftKings): spread: 63% of bets on Tigers, 21% of the money — Rams covered; total: 87% of bets on the over, 98% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 82% of bets on Tigers, 84% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Tigers, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.976 of the raw projection. It counts toward CBB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 1172 graded CBB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.978 and gives home teams +1.1 points. Team corrections so far: Tigers attack ×0.974, defense ×1.001 (7 games); Rams attack ×0.988, defense ×0.997 (7 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
